title: pastinaca calcarea
intro: Pastinaca calcarea, commonly known as turnip-rooted wild carrot or wild turnip, is a plant species in the Apiaceae family. It is a biennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pastinaca calcarea include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and calm the nervous system. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
